meta.title: Printopoly: make your own edition of the property-trading game
meta.description: Design your own edition of the classic property-trading game with your own streets and photos. The board is a sticker for the board you own. Free, no account.
hero.title: Make the property-trading game with your own streets.
hero.body: You stick the board onto the board you already own. Cards, title deeds and money you print new, at a print shop or on your own printer. Free, and no account needed.
hero.note: Your work stays in this browser. Log in with Google to continue on another computer.
hero.image.alt: Example: the board of the Saturday Club edition with a title deed, a Chance card and a Community Chest card
hero.caption: board approx. 500 × 500 mm · 4 panels · 3 mm bleed · 300 dpi
steps.title: How to make an edition
steps.intro: You start from the default edition. Whatever you do not change takes the style of your theme.
steps.1.title: Choose what you make
steps.1.body: Just the board, or the cards, money and pawns too. Whatever you skip, you take from your own box.
steps.2.title: Design space by space
steps.2.body: Pick a photo, drag it into place and type the name. Cards, money and pawns work the same way.
steps.3.title: Fix the warnings
steps.3.body: A photo that is too small or text that does not fit shows up right away, with the name of the space.
steps.4.title: Print and stick
steps.4.body: Choose the print-shop set or the home-print set. Each part says what to order or how to print it. A rules booklet, houses, dice and an invitation for your friends print along.
sets.title: What is in the sets
sets.shop.title: Print-shop set
sets.shop.item1: The board as four vinyl stickers with repositionable adhesive
sets.shop.item2: Cards and title deeds as a card set of 63 × 88 mm
sets.shop.item3: Money, pawns and box lid for the copy shop
sets.home.title: Home-print set
sets.home.item1: Each space a sticker on A4, the centre in four pieces
sets.home.item2: Cards on both sides, each back right behind its front
sets.home.item3: Money, pawns and box lid on A4 with crop marks
sets.share.title: Make it together
sets.share.item1: Send friends a link. They add streets, card texts and photos without an account
sets.share.item2: You check every contribution and take over what you like
sets.share.item3: The link expires by itself, and you can close it earlier
sets.share.art.question: Which street belongs here?
sets.share.art.name: Sam
sets.share.art.alt: Drawing: the page your friends see, with the name of the edition, a question about a street name and a button to send it in
sets.note: You can mix parts from both sets.
sticker.title: How to stick the board on
sticker.intro: The stickers stop 1 mm before each fold, so nothing tears when you close the board.
sticker.step1: Degrease the board and fit each panel dry first.
sticker.step2: Lay panel A against the outer corner and pull off 5 cm of backing paper.
sticker.step3: Press down with a bank card and peel off the rest slowly.
sticker.step4: Fold the board and check that the fold is free.
sticker.diagram.alt: Diagram: the board in four panels A to D, with 1 mm left free along the fold lines
